en.subtitle: Accessible dark fantasy RPG
en.promo: A full dungeon crawler RPG you can play by ear. 24 classes, endless modes and 100 achievements, made for VoiceOver by a blind developer.
en.description:
Descend into a dark fantasy dungeon you can play completely by ear. Dungeon Descent is a turn-based dungeon crawler RPG built from the ground up for VoiceOver and screen reader players, and fun for everyone. Made by a blind developer.

FULLY ACCESSIBLE
• Every button, room, enemy, attack and piece of loot is announced.
• Works with VoiceOver, voice commands, buttons and haptics.
• A step-by-step tutorial teaches everything.

FORGE YOUR LEGEND
• 24 classes, from Warrior and Paladin to Necromancer and Bard.
• 15 races and 11 professions, each with its own strengths.
• Choose your dungeon and your difficulty, from forgiving to one life only.

FIGHT, LOOT, SURVIVE
• Turn-based combat: attack, heavy strike, defend, potions, spells and class skills.
• Weapons, armor, runes, scrolls, a blacksmith and an arcane shop.
• Rooms full of traps, treasure, curses and bosses.

ENDLESS THINGS TO DO
• Endless Descent, The Spire, Void Mode, Boss Rush and more modes.
• Quests, daily challenges, seasonal events and a bestiary of hundreds of creatures.
• 100 Game Center achievements.

PLAY WITH OTHERS (OPTIONAL)
• Global chat, community-made enemies, leaderboards and tournaments.
• Every message and community enemy can be reported or blocked.

YOUR SAVE IS SAFE
• Progress saves on your device, with optional iCloud backup.
• An optional account syncs your progress. Sign in with Apple, Google or email, and delete your account any time in the game.

No ads. No purchases. Put on headphones and descend.
en.reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing Dungeon Descent.

PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Dungeon Descent is a turn-based dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG made by a blind developer for blind and visually impaired players, and playable by anyone. Everything is announced for VoiceOver, so people who cannot see the screen get a full RPG with character creation, combat, loot and many game modes. The game is in English.

HOW TO USE IT
No login is needed. Open the app, choose Play, create a character (class, race, profession, dungeon, difficulty) and choose Begin Descent. A tutorial explains everything. In the dungeon, use the North, South, East and West buttons to move, and Attack, Heavy, Defend, Potion and Flee in combat. Voice commands are optional (the Voice button). Headphones are recommended.

ACCOUNTS (OPTIONAL)
An account is not required to play. Players can optionally sign in with Apple, Google or email (Settings, Account) to sync progress. Delete Account is in the same Account panel and deletes the account. Players can also create one with any email and password; no demo account is needed.

PLAYER CONTENT
Global Chat and community-made enemies are written by players. Before posting the first time, players must agree to the Terms of Service (https://dungen-descent.org/terms), which have no tolerance for objectionable content. Messages and enemies are filtered for offensive words. Every message and every community enemy (Bestiary, Community tab) has Report and Block buttons. Reports are sent to the developer's email and reviewed within 24 hours; offending content is removed from Firebase. Blocked players and reported items are hidden right away.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Firebase (Google): optional accounts, cloud save sync, chat, leaderboards and community enemies.
- Sign in with Apple and Google Sign-In: optional login.
- Apple Game Center: achievements.
- Apple iCloud (CloudKit): optional backup of the save to the player's own iCloud.
- Apple Speech framework: optional voice commands.
- Formspree: sends feedback and content reports to the developer's email.
- Amazon Polly (through the developer's own server): narrator voice in one game mode.
No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no AI chat and no payment processor. The iOS version has no in-app purchases.

REGIONS
The app works the same in every region.

THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not a regulated industry. The game's characters, story and text are original. Music and sounds are licensed for use, and credits are in the game (Credits screen).
